title: Virginia SCC Morrisville-Wishing Star Transmission Case PUR-2026-00021
summary: The SCC transmission-project registry identifies a current multi-county 500 kV and 230 kV application as case PUR-2026-00021, creating a named docket to follow through decision and delivery.
key_findings: The case covers the Morrisville-Wishing Star 500 kV line and Anderson Branch-Morrisville 230 kV line.
The listed geography includes Fauquier, Prince William, and Loudoun counties.
Registry inclusion establishes a case, not an approval, route, completed line, or energization.
why_it_matters: It adds a current named transmission trail beyond the already approved Golden-Mars project.
ftfn_relevance: Links regional load pressure to a project-specific regulatory case.
Creates a later decision, route, construction, and service trail.
Prevents a case filing from being treated as delivered capacity.
evidence_limits: The registry page does not establish a final order.
It does not prove land rights, construction, energization, or customer service.
